family: low-nibble-0x2 INTEGER/FLOAT COMPARE - MIN/MAX - SELECT - CARRY family (byte0 0x02..0xf2; byte0 HIGH nibble = destination register r0..r15, byte0 LOW nibble 0x2 = family). Roots 0x02 (dst r0) and 0x22 (dst r2) in the census are the SAME ops at different dst regs. Provoked with OWN-MSL (EXP-M4-13 R2). Clean-room: dst + op-select proven by byte-diffing our own compiled min/max/select/carry shaders; NO Apple binary inspected; NO GPU dispatch (compile+extract+tokenize+byte-diff only on this M4 host).
byte0Model: byte0 low nibble == 0x2 selects this family; byte0 HIGH nibble = destination register (r0..r15). PROVEN by an 8-register sweep (dec2_n2_intalu/k_minmax_dst): 8 simultaneously-live imin ops emit byte0 high nibbles {e,d,b,9,7,5,3,1} tracking 8 distinct dst regs while the op bytes (byte+2==0x1e, byte+4==0x07) stay constant. byte1 = (dst<<1)|size, the full destination descriptor (redundant with byte0-hi for reg<16). This is the SAME byte0 model as the low-nibble-0x9 float ALU and low-nibble-0xa icmp_pred families.

opSelectMap.note: The min/max OP-SELECT is byte+4 (NOT byte+2 as the base DB's 'op' field implied). byte+2 is a source-format/width marker. PROVEN: k_imin/k_imax/k_umin/k_umax/k_fmin/k_fmax are byte-identical except byte+4.

lengthRules.applyWhen: byte0 low-nibble==0x2 AND byte+2<=0x3f AND base instr_length returns None (i.e. dst reg NOT already covered by the EXP-M4-01 per-dst rules)
lengthRules.lengthBitNote: DEFAULT 6-byte form (min/max / carry / compact select). ONLY applied where the committed EXP-M4-01 rule returns LEN_UNKNOWN, so it can never change an existing length -> zero tokenization regression. Generalises the min/max + compact-select length to ALL 16 dst regs (the committed rule hard-coded dst r0..r3).
icmpsel compare->const select at a dst reg other than r1 (base only lengthed 0x0d for byte0==0x12).
register-operand select / madd; byte+4 bit1 = wide-srcC (trailing operand word).

descriptors.semantics: d = min/max(a,b) by TYPE (32-bit int signed/unsigned, or float). byte0 low-nibble 2 = family; byte0 high nibble (dst) = destination reg r0..r15 (PROVEN, 8-reg sweep). byte1 = (dst<<1)|size. byte+2 = source-format/addressing marker (bits[17:18]==0b11 matched: 0x1e register, 0x0e srcB-immediate, 0x2e/0x3e chained-source min3/median3, 0x26/0x36 float sibling). byte+3 = srcA. byte+4 = OP-SELECT (sel = low 3 bits): 0=fmax 1=fmin 4=umax 5=umin 6=imax 7=imin. selhi (byte+4 upper 5 bits) = srcB-immediate-mode flag. byte+5 = srcB. Unifies the former dst-pinned iminmax(r0)/fminmax(r1)/iminmax_chain(r2).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (OWN-MSL; compile-only, NO GPU dispatch). dst=byte0-hi PROVEN: dec2_n2_intalu/k_minmax_dst emits 8 simultaneously-live imin ops with byte0 high nibbles e,d,b,9,7,5,3,1 (8 distinct dst regs) while byte+2==0x1e, byte+4==0x07 stay constant. op-select=byte+4 PROVEN: k_imin/imax/umin/umax/fmin/fmax are byte-identical except byte+4=07/06/05/04/01/00. srcA/srcB/sel inherit EXP-0007 HW validation. fmt/selhi upper-bit semantics INFERRED (captured for round-trip). NOT HW-dispatch validated (M4 host is compile-only).

descriptors.semantics: d = min/max(a,b), 16-bit (half/half2) form. Identical layout to the 32-bit iminmax but byte+2 == 0x1c (16-bit width marker) and byte+4 carries bit4 set. byte+4 low 3 bits = op-select (0=hmax 1=hmin). PROVEN by k_hmin/k_hmax which differ only in byte+4 (0x11 min vs 0x10 max).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (OWN-MSL). k_hmin=`12 02 1c 02 11 c0`, k_hmax=`12 02 1c 02 10 c0`; byte+2==0x1c is the 16-bit min/max marker, byte+4 low-3-bits the min/max op-select (same as the 32-bit form). dst=byte0-hi from the family sweep. NOT HW-dispatch validated.

descriptors.semantics: d = (a <cond> b) ? K1 : K0 ; integer/float compare feeding a 0/1 (or const) select, 14-byte form. dst = byte0 high nibble. byte1 = (dst<<1)|size. byte+2 low nibble 0xd = compare-select marker (fmt = upper nibble 0/1/2 for 0x0d/0x1d/0x2d). byte+3 = srcA. byte+4 = cmpmode (0x22 relational | 0x26 equality). byte+6 = cond predicate. byte+7.. = the two selected constants + srcB descriptor (body).
descriptors.provenance: Generalises HW-VALIDATED icmpsel (EXP-0013: 18 compare kernels correct, byte+6 predicate map + byte+4 relational<->equality splice). Widened EXP-M4-13 R2 from byte0==0x12 (dst r1) to low-nibble-2 all dst (byte+2 lo-nibble 0xd). dst=byte0-hi from the family sweep. k_icmp01 reproduces the r1 form byte-exact. NOT HW-dispatch validated.

descriptors.semantics: carry = (a + b overflowed) ? 1 : 0 ; carry-generate half of a multi-word (u64) add. byte+2 == 0x35 carry marker. dst = byte0 high nibble. byte+3 = srcA, byte+4 = cmpmode. Feeds a psel that folds the carry into the high word.
descriptors.provenance: Generalises HW+SPLICE-VALIDATED carry_gen (EXP-0038: u64 carry correct; neutralizing byte0 0x32->0x00 or byte+4 0x22->0x26 drops carry). Widened EXP-M4-13 R2 from byte0==0x32 (dst r3) to low-nibble-2 all dst. k_u64add reproduces `32 01 35 03 22 81` byte-exact. NOT HW-dispatch validated.

descriptors.semantics: d = (predicate) ? a : b ; register-operand compare-select, 10-byte form (byte+2 0x2f). Emitted in the integer division/modulo correction (quotient adjust). dst = byte0 high nibble, srcA = byte+3, body = 2nd operand + compare descriptor.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (OWN-MSL). byte+2 0x2f 10-byte reg-select in u_div/s_div/s_mod. dst=byte0-hi from the family sweep; bit-packing beyond dst/srcA INFERRED (raw). NOT HW-dispatch validated. Clean-room: the DIVISION ALGORITHM is NOT reconstructed, only this op's encoding.

descriptors.semantics: d = (predicate) ? a : b ; register-operand select, 8-byte form (byte+2 0x25, register srcC). dst = byte0 high nibble, srcA = byte+3, body = 2nd operand + compare descriptor.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (OWN-MSL). byte+2 0x25 8-byte reg-select (k_int64 `92 8f 25 8b 85 19 07 00`). dst=byte0-hi from the family sweep; bit-packing beyond dst/srcA INFERRED (raw). NOT HW-dispatch validated.

descriptors.semantics: Generic 6-byte low-nibble-2 op (dst = byte0 high nibble). Covers the compact select/predicate helpers and the SFU polynomial/range-reduction SELECT steps (byte+2 op-selects 0x21/0x23/0x2b/0x03/0x3d/0x3f and the compact 0x00/0x18/0x09 forms) that are NOT the min/max, carry, or compare-select ops named above. Byte-level fields only; per-op-select semantics UNRESOLVED (and, for the transcendental range-reduction selects, deliberately NOT reconstructed per clean-room rule 5).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 catch-all. dst=byte0-hi from the family sweep. Generalises the byte0-only iminmax/fminmax/iminmax_chain catch-all behaviour of the base DB to all dst regs, but WITHOUT asserting a min/max op-select for these non-min/max forms. Byte fields captured for clean tokenization + round-trip; op semantics UNRESOLVED.

notes: Turns the low-nibble-0x2 family from length-only/desync into FULL field-level decode across ALL 16 dst regs. Core correction: the min/max OP-SELECT lives in byte+4 (sel), not byte+2 -- the base DB's dst-pinned iminmax(0x02)/fminmax(0x12)/iminmax_chain(0x22) are the SAME 6-byte min/max op at dst r0/r1/r2 (e.g. iminmax_chain `22 01 1e 05 07 c0` is imin->r2, byte-for-byte an imin), so they are UNIFIED into one dst-agnostic `iminmax` (32-bit int + float) plus `hminmax` (16-bit). carry_gen (EXP-0038 HW) and icmpsel (EXP-0013 HW) keep their validated field layouts and are only widened from one dst reg to all 16. A low-specificity `n2_op6` catch-all preserves clean tokenization of the remaining 6-byte forms (compact selects, SFU range-reduction selects) for all dst regs -- exactly the role the base DB's byte0-only iminmax/fminmax played, but WITHOUT falsely asserting a min/max op-select for non-min/max bytes. APPLYING requires: (1) remove base descriptors iminmax/fminmax/iminmax_chain/icmpsel/carry_gen; add the 8 descriptors here; (2) add the guarded length generalisation (only fires where the committed rule returns LEN_UNKNOWN); (3) update roundtrip_test.py SYNTH: the old `('fminmax',{dst,op,srcA,sel,mods})` and `('iminmax',{b1,op,...})` entries move to the new unified iminmax field schema {dst,dst_full,fmt,srcA,sel,selhi,srcB} (this proposal ships that validated update, ALL PASS). No other family's descriptors, matches, or lengths change; whole-corpus leftover is byte-for-byte <= base on every file (28 files strictly improved, 0 regressed).
provenance: Clean-room byte-diff, EXP-M4-13 R2, OWN-MSL only. All probe shaders in experiments/EXP-M4-13-full-corpus/corpus/dec2_n2_intalu/ compiled with our own shdump (compile-only; NO GPU dispatch on the M4 host -- shdump never dispatches) and tokenized with our own isadb/agxparse. No Apple binary was inspected. dst=byte0-hi and op-select=byte+4 are byte-diff PROVEN from our own shaders; srcA/srcB operand positions and the icmpsel/carry_gen field layouts inherit prior HARDWARE validation (EXP-0007/EXP-0013/EXP-0038); fmt/selhi upper-bit semantics and the isel_reg/n2_op6 sub-field packing are byte-diff INFERRED (captured for round-trip, flagged in unresolved). NOT HW-dispatch validated on this M4 host.
